data.name: Hollow Glow
data.detailed_description:
In the run-down town of Kirchheim, the last shred of lightheartedness has been lost. Night after night, children disappear without a trace – first the strays, then the sheltered. The desperate townsfolk search for someone to blame, turning their wrath upon the woman at the edge of town, decried as a witch. No one believes her innocence, yet she alone knows the dark entity behind the abductions.

Trapped within her witch's house on Samhain, the day when the boundary between worlds is thinnest, she summons a ghost. Its mission: follow the trail of the missing children and rid the town of the "Mothman"…

Key Features:

  • Become an Invisible Observer: Use your ghostly form to overhear the living unseen, listen to whispered monologues, and unearth the truth behind Kirchheim's walls.

  • Explore an Eerily Beautiful 3D World: Traverse shadowy, atmospheric environments in a third-person perspective inspired by classic retro horror.

  • Cryptic Environmental Puzzles: Interact with the environment and use items cleverly to bypass barriers and close in on the Mothman.

  • Silent Stealth Over Combat: Evade the lurking dangers of the night. Rely on patience and your surroundings to slip past threats completely unnoticed.

  • A Deep, Mature Narrative: Uncover dark secrets and buried traumas in a linear, story-driven psychological mystery.

data.short_description: A quiet, third-person cozy horror adventure. Explore a mysterious world as a ghost, solve subtle puzzles, and uncover dark truths in Kirchheim while silently evading danger. No hectic combat, just pure, deep atmosphere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Requirements may change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for smoother loading.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mature themes with visual and textual references to adult themes, prostitution, and abuse. It also includes visual depictions and thematic mentions of violence, death, and suicide. Additionally, the consumption, use, and depiction of both legal and illegal substances are featured throughout the experience.
